setupWarnings.message: This dead-letter queue drops Messages for good before anyone triages them. It has a length limit of 1000 Messages with drop-head overflow: when it is full, the oldest Message is dropped. Remove the length limit or set overflow = reject-publish, or give the queue a dead-letter exchange so these Messages move on instead.

This quorum queue has the default delivery-limit (20) and no dead-letter exchange: a Message returned to it abnormally more than 20 times (a crash, a lost connection, a rejection) is dropped for good. Set delivery-limit = -1 (for example with a policy) to never drop, or give the queue a dead-letter exchange.

This quorum queue dead-letters with the default at-most-once strategy: a Message it dead-letters is lost if the dead-letter exchange routes it to no queue at that moment, or if a broker node fails while it moves. Set dead-letter-strategy = at-least-once together with overflow = reject-publish (at-least-once needs it): the queue then keeps each dead-lettered Message until a dead-letter queue has confirmed it.

This quorum queue has a delivery-limit of 5 and no dead-letter exchange: a Message returned to it abnormally more than 5 times (a crash, a lost connection, a rejection) is dropped for good. Set delivery-limit = -1 (for example with a policy) to never drop, or give the queue a dead-letter exchange.

This dead-letter queue drops Messages for good before anyone triages them. It has a message TTL of 86400000 ms: a Message that waits longer is dropped. Remove the message TTL, or give the queue a dead-letter exchange so these Messages move on instead.

This queue dead-letters to the exchange "billing.dlx", which does not exist in this vhost: every Message it dead-letters (rejected, expired, over a length or delivery limit) is dropped for good. Declare the exchange "billing.dlx" and bind a dead-letter queue to it, or point the queue's dead-letter-exchange at one that exists.

checkout.reason: Stream queues cannot be checked out: a stream keeps its Messages after they are read, so there is nothing to hold and settle one by one. Only classic and quorum queues can be triaged.
